notes: Ambient sound, made inside the app: rain that's muffled when you're indoors, wind and gusts (stronger in a storm or a Hollow), thunder, the low hum of the city, crowd murmur in cafés, arcades and stations, music thumping through the wall at the livehouse, the metro rumbling, and crickets on warm nights. Your phone buzzes when a text comes in. It starts after your first click. Turn it off or change the volume in Settings.
